text:
Make a silent 8-second vertical coffee clip: a close-up of coffee being poured into a ceramic cup for the first 5 seconds, then a plain black end card for the final 3 seconds. On the end card, center this exact URL in white, all on one line: https://example.com/Go?ref=June
Keep the capitals and punctuation exactly as typed. Nothing else written anywhere. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
